briefing.ja: ノースゲート・ホテルのロビーで、傘立てに預けられていた客の傘が9時から9時30分の間に持ち去られた。旅先で買った記念の傘であり、持ち主にとって大切な品である。ロビーにいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: A guest's umbrella was taken from the stand in the lobby of the Northgate Hotel between 09:00 and 09:30. She bought it on a trip and wants it back. One of the six people in the lobby is the thief, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

text.2: Nobody was behind the front desk from 09:10.
text.3: From about ten past nine there was nobody at the front desk.
text.4: Anyone who came to the desk after ten past would have found it unattended.
text.5: The minutes all run together for me, but I am fairly sure nobody was behind the front desk from around ten past nine.

facts.hintJa: front desk = フロント / behind = 〜の後ろに / empty = 誰もいない

text.2: The staff corridor door was locked until 09:20.
text.3: The door to the staff corridor stayed locked until twenty past nine.
text.4: Had anyone wanted the staff corridor before twenty past, they would have had to ask me to unlock it.
text.5: I keep that key myself, so I would be surprised if the staff corridor door was open before twenty past nine.

facts.hintJa: staff corridor = 従業員通路 / locked = 鍵がかかっている / stay = 〜のままである

text.1: Lobby sofa. I saw the room. Until 09:18.
text.2: From the lobby sofa I could see the room until 09:18.
text.3: I was sitting on the lobby sofa, and I could see most of the room until about eighteen minutes past.
text.4: Right up to eighteen minutes past, there was not much of that lobby I could not see from my sofa.
text.5: My mind was on my phone, to be honest, but from that sofa I could see most of the lobby until about eighteen minutes past nine.

facts.hintJa: sofa = ソファ / view = 見える範囲 / most of = 〜の大半

text.1: Elevator. Doors open. Ground floor. Until 09:20.
text.2: The elevator stood open on the ground floor until 09:20.
text.3: The elevator sat there with its doors open on the ground floor until twenty past nine.
text.4: The car had not moved off the ground floor by twenty past, and its doors were still open.
text.5: Nobody had called it up as far as I know, and the elevator stood on the ground floor with its doors open until about twenty past nine.

facts.hintJa: elevator = エレベーター / doors = 扉 / car = かご

text.1: The umbrella. In the stand. At 09:10.
text.2: The umbrella was still in the stand at 09:10.
text.3: The umbrella was definitely still in the stand when I passed it at ten past nine.
text.4: Nobody had taken that umbrella yet when I glanced over at ten past.
text.5: I could not put an exact time on it, but the umbrella was still in the stand at around ten past nine.

facts.hintJa: umbrella = 傘 / stand = 傘立て / still = まだ

text.1: The owner. Went to breakfast. At 09:12.
text.2: The owner went to breakfast at 09:12.
text.3: The guest it belonged to went in for breakfast at about twelve past nine.
text.4: She left it there and went through for breakfast, two minutes or so after ten past.
text.5: She did not say where she was going, but I think the owner went through for breakfast at roughly twelve minutes past nine.

facts.hintJa: owner = 持ち主 / breakfast = 朝食 / go through = 通って入る

text.2: My trolley blocked the front entrance from 09:13 to 09:17.
text.3: I had my trolley wedged in the front entrance from thirteen past until seventeen past.
text.4: For those four minutes, the only way past that trolley was over the top of it.
text.5: I was in a hurry with the boxes, so the trolley sat across the front entrance from about thirteen past until seventeen past nine.

facts.hintJa: trolley = 台車 / block = ふさぐ / wedge = 押し込む

text.1: Van doors. Open. Towards the entrance. Until 09:25.
text.2: The doors of my van were open towards the entrance until 09:25.
text.3: The van was parked right in front of the entrance with its back doors open until twenty-five past.
text.4: You could not step out of that entrance without squeezing round my open van doors.
text.5: I forget when I finally shut them, but the van was standing in front of the entrance with its doors open until about twenty-five past nine.

facts.hintJa: van = 配送車 / entrance = 入口 / squeeze round = 体をよけて通る

text.1: Office door. I watched it. Until 09:20.
text.2: I had the office door in sight until 09:20.
text.3: I had my eye on the office door right up to twenty past nine.
text.4: If somebody had opened that office door before twenty past, I would have seen them do it.
text.5: I will not pretend I never blinked, but the office door was in front of me until about twenty minutes past nine.

facts.hintJa: office = 事務室 / in sight = 見えるところに / have an eye on = 目を離さない

text.2: No check-in was recorded between 09:05 and 09:25.
text.3: Nobody checked in between five past and twenty-five past nine.
text.4: The system would have a record if anybody had checked in during those twenty minutes.
text.5: I have looked since, and unless the system missed it, there is no check-in at all between five past and twenty-five past nine.

facts.hintJa: check-in = 宿泊の受付 / record = 記録する / system = 端末の記録

text.1: Doorway. I saw the lobby. 09:10 to 09:20.
text.2: From the breakfast room doorway I saw the lobby from 09:10 to 09:20.
text.3: I could see the lobby through the doorway from ten past to twenty past.
text.4: The doorway gives me a view of the lobby, and I was standing in it from ten past to twenty past.
text.5: I was busy with the buffet, but the breakfast room doorway looks out on the lobby, and I was standing there from ten past to twenty past.

facts.hintJa: doorway = 戸口 / breakfast room = 朝食会場 / buffet = 食事の並んだ台

text.2: The linen room was locked between 09:10 and 09:20.
text.3: I locked the linen room at ten past and had the key on me until twenty past.
text.4: That room stays shut unless I unlock it, and I did not unlock it before twenty past.
text.5: I lock it out of habit whenever I leave, and the key stayed in my pocket from ten past until twenty past nine.

facts.hintJa: linen room = リネン室 / lock = 鍵をかける / key = 鍵

text.1: Me. In the linen room. At 09:15.
text.2: I was in the linen room at 09:15.
text.3: I went into the linen room for a clean cloth at a quarter past.
text.4: By then I was in the linen room hunting for a clean cloth, well out of sight of the lobby.
text.5: I doubt I could pin down the minute, but I had gone into the linen room for a clean cloth by about a quarter past nine.

lie.hintJa: linen room = リネン室 / cloth = 布 / go through = 通って入る

contradictions.meaningJa: Hanaは9時15分にリネン室にいたと言うが、Yuiは9時10分にリネン室へ鍵をかけ、その鍵を自分のポケットに入れていたと言っている。9時10分に傘がまだ傘立てにあったという証言で時間帯が絞られ、Sotaの視界とTakuの台車とEmiの視線で、その間にロビーを離れられた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I went out the front entrance at 09:13.
text.3: I walked out through the front entrance at about thirteen past and waited outside.
text.4: I was already outside getting some air by then, so whatever happened, it happened without me.
text.5: The clock was the last thing on my mind, but I was already out through the front entrance by about thirteen minutes past nine.

lie.hintJa: go out = 外へ出る / entrance = 入口 / air = 外の空気

contradictions.meaningJa: Sotaは9時13分に正面の入口から外へ出たと言うが、Takuの台車が9時13分から9時17分まで正面の出入口を塞いでいた。HanaとEmiとYuiの証言と、9時10分に傘が傘立てにあったという証言で、その時間帯に他の出口が使えなかったことも分かる。

text.2: I took the elevator up at 09:15.
text.3: I went up in the elevator at about a quarter past nine.
text.4: I had taken the elevator up to the second floor, so I was not in the lobby.
text.5: My rounds take me upstairs about that time, and I am fairly sure I rode the elevator up at around a quarter past nine.

lie.hintJa: upstairs = 上の階 / elevator = エレベーター / floor = 階

contradictions.meaningJa: Rioは9時15分にエレベーターで上の階へ行ったと言うが、Sotaは9時20分までエレベーターの扉が1階で開いたままだったと言っている。上の階への階段は従業員通路の先にあり、Hanaはその扉が9時20分まで施錠されていたと言う。Yuiの戸口からの視界とTakuの台車とEmiの視線で、その時間帯にロビーから抜けられなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was in the back office at 09:15.
text.3: I was in the back office waiting for a signature on my delivery sheet at a quarter past.
text.4: The paperwork kept me in the back office, so I was nowhere near that umbrella stand.
text.5: Whoever signed the sheet will remember better than I do, but I think I was in the back office at around a quarter past nine.

lie.hintJa: back office = 奥の事務室 / signature = 署名 / paperwork = 事務作業

contradictions.meaningJa: Takuは9時15分に奥の事務室にいたと言うが、Emiは9時20分まで事務室の扉を見ており、誰も入っていない。持ち主が9時12分に朝食会場へ向かったという証言があり、HanaとSotaとYuiの証言で、その直後のロビーの様子が分かる。

text.2: I went out through the staff corridor at 09:15.
text.3: I took the rubbish out along the staff corridor at about a quarter past nine.
text.4: The rubbish goes out along the staff corridor, and that is where I was, not in the lobby.
text.5: It is the one job I never forget, so I would say I was out along the staff corridor with the rubbish at around a quarter past nine.

lie.hintJa: staff corridor = 従業員通路 / rubbish = ごみ / take out = 外へ出す

contradictions.meaningJa: Emiは9時15分に従業員通路から外へ出たと言うが、Hanaは通路の扉が9時20分まで施錠されていたと言っている。Takuの配送車が入口の前に停まっていたこと、Sotaの視界、9時10分に傘が傘立てにあったという証言、Yuiの戸口からの視界で、その時間帯にホテルを出た者がいないことが分かる。

text.1: Me. At the front desk. At 09:15.
text.2: I was at the front desk at 09:15.
text.3: I was covering the front desk at about a quarter past nine.
text.4: By then I had left the buffet to somebody else and was standing at the front desk.
text.5: It is hardly my job, but I think I had come out to stand at the front desk at around a quarter past nine.

lie.hintJa: front desk = フロント / cover = 代わりに担当する / hardly = ほとんど〜ない

contradictions.meaningJa: Yuiは9時15分にフロントにいたと言うが、Hanaは9時10分以降フロントに誰も立っていなかったと言っている。Emiの受付の記録、9時10分に傘が傘立てにあったという証言、Sotaの視界、Takuの台車で、その時間帯に受付が行われていなかったことが分かる。

timelineEn: 09:05 The guest left her umbrella in the stand by the door.
09:10 The umbrella was still in the stand.
09:12 The guest went through to the breakfast room.
09:15 The umbrella was taken from the stand.
09:20 The guest came back and the umbrella was gone.

keyExpressions.en: Who else was in the lobby then?
keyExpressions.ja: そのとき、ほかに誰がロビーにいましたか。

keyExpressions.en: I could not put an exact time on it, but...
keyExpressions.ja: 正確な時刻は言えませんが…

keyExpressions.en: One of you must be mistaken.
keyExpressions.ja: どちらかが間違っています。
